now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#13
now.text: Tucker Shockley orders Jemma Simmons killed after she saves Vijay Nadeer during his Terrigenesis. She later goes up against Shockley herself in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s fight with the Watchdogs.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman with the Watchdogs, who orders Jemma killed for saving Vijay.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist Shockley orders killed for saving Vijay Nadeer, who later fights him.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#9
proposed.text: Tucker Shockley orders Jemma Simmons killed after she saves Vijay Nadeer from his Terrigenesis and comes asking questions at Senator Nadeer's office.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Watchdog who orders Jemma killed for saving Vijay.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist Shockley orders killed for saving Vijay Nadeer.

changes.evidence: Shockley orders Bynum to assassinate Simmons in S4E9 'Broken Promises' (ref AoS409), not E13. He only turns Inhuman in E13 'BOOM', so 'An Inhuman' on the card would spoil E13 at E9. The E13 facts move to a new stage (next entry).

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#13
proposed.text: Terrigen meant for Nadeer turns Shockley into an Inhuman who explodes and reforms. Simmons and Fitz trap his ashes in a device they built.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An Inhuman Watchdog whom Jemma and Fitz trap.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A scientist who helps trap Shockley.

changes.evidence: S4E13 'BOOM': Shockley becomes Inhuman; Daisy distracts him while Fitz and Simmons contain him in a specially made device.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#10
now.text: Director Jeffrey Mace sends Mack and Coulson to bring in Daisy, now the vigilante Quake. When the Watchdogs shoot down Mace's Quinjet in Freyer National Park, Mack takes out the mercenaries sent to kill him.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's Director, whom Mack saves from the Watchdogs' mercenaries.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who saves Mace from the Watchdogs' mercenaries.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#1
proposed.text: Jeffrey Mace is S.H.I.E.L.D.'s new Director and Mack's boss. He orders Mack and Coulson off their hunt for Daisy, now the vigilante Quake.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's new Director, who orders him off the hunt for Daisy.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent Mace orders off the hunt for Daisy.

changes.evidence: Mace is Mack's Director from S4E1 'The Ghost', where he pulls Mack and Coulson off the hunt for Daisy (Wikipedia: they were 'forbidden from searching for Daisy by new S.H.I.E.L.D. Director Jeffrey Mace'). By E10 Daisy is already back: Mace holds a press conference for her, so 'sends Mack and Coulson to bring in Daisy' is wrong at E10. The Quinjet events stay at E10 (next entry).

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#10
proposed.text: When the Watchdogs bring down Mace's Quinjet in Freyer National Park, Mack and Coulson take out the mercenaries sent to kill him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Mack's Director, whom Mack saves from the Watchdogs' mercenaries.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who saves Mace from the Watchdogs' mercenaries.

changes.evidence: S4E10 'The Patriot': the Quinjet crashes in Freyer National Park, and Coulson and Mack fight off the ex-Hydra mercenaries hired by the Watchdogs.

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#7
now.text: Mr. Charles is a CIA operative who tries to recruit Jessica, and she turns him down. His agents later attack her home.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A CIA operative Jessica turns down, whose agents attack her home.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A recruit who turns Mr. Charles down. His agents later attack her home.

changes.evidence: In S2E6 'Requiem' Mr. Charles sends men to attack Jessica's house (she fights them off) and she tells Daredevil she turned down his offer. E7 'The Hateful Darkness' is only her follow-up confrontation with him.

now.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
now.text: In the end Sheila breaks with Fisk, and once he is gone she takes over as interim mayor of New York.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Sheila's former boss. She breaks with him, then takes over as interim mayor.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's former chief of staff. Breaks with him and becomes interim mayor.

changes.evidence: Sheila stays Fisk's chief of staff through S2. She turns on him only in the finale, S2E8 'The Southern Cross', when she brings him the exile offer ('Kingpin is furious that Rivera is turning on him'). A season-wide S2 stage makes her his rival from S2E1.

now.text: Once the FBI frees Fisk, Karen works to put him back in prison. She taunts him with the truth about Wesley's death, and Fisk sends Poindexter to kill her.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The freed crime lord Karen fights, who sends Poindexter to kill her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The woman who taunts Fisk about Wesley, whom he sends Poindexter to kill.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#3
proposed.text: Once the FBI frees Fisk, Karen digs into his deals to put him back in prison.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The freed crime lord Karen digs into.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The woman who digs into Fisk's deals after his release.

changes.evidence: The stage sits on S3E10, but its facts start earlier: Fisk is moved to the hotel and Karen begins investigating him in S3E3 'No Good Deed'. She taunts him about Wesley in S3E8 'Upstairs/Downstairs'. Dex attacks her at Clinton Church in S3E10 'Karen'. The proposal splits the stage into E3, E8 and E10 (the next two entries).

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The crime lord Karen taunts with the truth about Wesley.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The woman who taunts Fisk that she killed Wesley.

changes.evidence: S3E8 'Upstairs/Downstairs': Karen confronts Fisk and reveals she killed Wesley.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#10
proposed.text: Fisk sends Poindexter to Clinton Church to kill Karen.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The crime lord who sends Poindexter to kill Karen.

changes.evidence: S3E9 ends with Fisk's FBI agents finding Karen at Clinton Church. In S3E10 'Karen', Dex, dressed as Daredevil, attacks the church to kill her.

now.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#25
now.text: Montana fights Spider-Man as the Shocker and nearly crushes him in a garbage compactor. Later he leads the new Enforcers until Spider-Man locks them in the Vault.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Leads the Enforcers until Peter locks them in the Vault.

proposed.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#4
proposed.text: Montana fights Spider-Man as the Shocker in a trap at a landfill and knocks him into a machine, leaving him for dead.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The hero Montana is hired to kill.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An Enforcer who attacks Peter at a landfill as the Shocker.

changes.evidence: Montana first becomes the Shocker and fights Spider-Man in S1E4 'Market Forces'. He attacks him at a landfill and knocks him into a machine. Episode 25 (S2E12 'Opening Night') is the Vault breakout, so #25 is the wrong start. The current cards ('again and again', the Vault) spoil later episodes. The new Enforcers move to their own stage (next entry).

proposed.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#22
proposed.text: Montana leads the new Enforcers, armed by the Tinkerer, against Spider-Man.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Leads the new Enforcers against Peter.

changes.evidence: Episode 22 (S2E9 'Probable Cause'): Spider-Man faces the Enforcers (Shocker, Fancy Dan and Ox), who have new gear from the Tinkerer.

owner_calls.question: Should this stage start at #12 or #25? The break-in and Ben's shooting are shown in the #12 flashback ('Intervention'), where the burglar is not named. He is revealed as Walter Hardy only in #25 ('Opening Night').
options: Keep #25 (where he is identified as Walter Hardy)
Move to #12 (where the killing is shown)
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom: the Burglar holds Ben and May at gunpoint, grabs May and shoots Ben (ref 'Interventions', S1E12). Spider-Man recognizes Walter as Ben's killer in 'Opening Night' (S2E12).

owner_calls.question: The stages are listed with X-Men '97#10 before Spider-Man (1994)#61, but in story order the Secret War comes first. Fandom says Cap goes to work for the government after the Secret War. Should the stages be reordered? Both stages are factually correct.
owner_calls.evidence: Steven Rogers (Earth-92131): the Secret War (Spider-Man 1994 S5E9-11) comes before his X-Men '97 S1E7 and S1E10 appearances.
